sources.description: LiveBench 2.0 contamination-free long-horizon AI benchmark evaluating models on real agentic work (decks, research reports, bug fixes, apps that run for hours) alongside objective reasoning, coding, and data analysis.

benchmark_standards.description: LiveBench 2.0: Contamination-free long-horizon AI benchmark evaluating models on real agentic tasks (bug fixes, decks, research reports, web apps) alongside objective reasoning and coding.
benchmark_standards.methodological_limitations: Evaluates objective reasoning, real-world tasks, and automated execution; individual category scores are not directly comparable without methodology weighting.

benchmark_standards.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmark_standards.description: Human-validated subset of 500 real GitHub issue resolution tasks in Python repositories.
benchmark_standards.methodological_limitations: Evaluates Python repository issue resolution with unit tests; computationally demanding harness.

benchmark_standards.name: Chatbot Arena (LMSYS)
benchmark_standards.description: Crowdsourced blind head-to-head pairwise comparisons evaluated with Bradley-Terry / Elo rating system.
benchmark_standards.methodological_limitations: Reflects human subjective preference and prompt distribution; susceptible to formatting and verbosity bias.

benchmark_standards.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmark_standards.description: 448 multiple-choice graduate-level biology, chemistry, and physics questions designed by experts to be non-Googleable.
benchmark_standards.methodological_limitations: Multiple-choice format with limited scope; difficult for non-expert human graders.

benchmark_standards.name: MMLU-Pro
benchmark_standards.description: Rigorous 10-choice multidisciplinary reasoning benchmark designed to overcome MMLU saturation.
benchmark_standards.methodological_limitations: 10-option multiple choice; tests academic and factual recall more than extended agentic reasoning.

benchmark_standards.name: MATH 500 / AIME
benchmark_standards.description: Advanced competition mathematics problems from AMC, AIME, and high school Olympiads.
benchmark_standards.methodological_limitations: Requires formal symbol manipulation and proof techniques; difficult for standard language models without test-time compute.
